signatures.purpose: The identity line: the public identity and the locked descriptor on the opening sheet, the registry counts, and the search form whose black submit is the primary action.
The contents index: the seven canonical domains as ruled rows, each listing every published article as a plain link.
The featured article: one title and its lead, verbatim and within 50 words, chosen by date.
The featured scene: one registered motion scene on its poster frame that plays only when the reader starts it.
Did you know: three short facts, each cited and linked to the article that states it.
Recently updated: the five latest dated article changes, newest first.
The tools line: one row of plain links to the playground and the market map.
